entities.name: Neoliberalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Economic and political philosophy advocating free markets, deregulation, privatization, and reduced government spending. Dominant from the 1980s under Reagan and Thatcher, it reshaped global economic policy and trade frameworks.
